statusMessage:

Received string:      "Karlovy Vary International Film Festival

Allwyn are proud sponsors of KVIFF, one of the oldest film festivals in the world, and its Future Frames programme.

At Allwyn, we believe that lotteries have the power to change lives for the better by helping people achieve their full potential. Being the global partner of KVIFF and Future Frames is something we’re extremely proud of.

Allwyn at the KVIFF
About

Allwyn endeavours to empower people in every walk of life. That’s why we’re the proud partner of the **Karlovy Vary International Film Festival.** Through the partnership, we support the **Future Frames** programme. As part of the collaboration, we sponsor a month-long scholarship to Los Angeles for one director each year where they can learn from the best in the film industry, with a dedicated programme of mentoring, shadowing and training.

Global partner

At Allwyn, we believe that lotteries have the power to change lives for the better by helping people achieve their full potential.​ Being the global partner of KVIFF and Future Frames is something we’re extremely proud of.

“Bringing people and communities together is something that matters more than ever before. Collaborating with KVIFF and the Future Frames initiative enables Allwyn to support that mission.”

Pavel Turek
Chief Officer Global Partnerships
Helping tomorrow's stars reach their full potential today

Since 2023, Allwyn has partnered with Future Frames to sponsor a month-long scholarship to Los Angeles for one director each year to learn from the best in the film industry, with a dedicated programme of mentoring, shadowing and training.

Find out more
